# wild

> Machine-checked compatibility and composition of software components, modelled
> as a category of contracts. Machine-checked compatibility for software
> components, first-party or third-party.

wild is a design with a prototype and a Rust implementation. The `wild extract`
and `wild check` subcommands are implemented and runtime-tested; the manual
describes the intended interface and marks what is implemented. The publishable
package name is `wild-vibes` (crates.io collision); the repository, binary, and
wire-format identities remain `wild`.

- [Manual](docs/wild-manual.md): how the tool works and how to use it (start here).
- [Wild v1 formats](docs/wild-formats-v1.md): normative design protocol for
  contracts, manifests, locks, sidecars, policy and certificate bundles.
- [JSON Schema](schemas/wild-v1.schema.json): validation for the v1 protocol.
- [Structural examples](schemas/examples-v1.json): worked examples of the v1 protocol.

## Specs

- [wild](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild.html): root spec; software-updates adoption path.
- [wild-core](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild-core.html): core notions (contracts, tiers, compatibility).
- [wild-tiers](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild-tiers.html): tier ordering and accretion.
- [wild-compose](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild-compose.html): composition, subsumption, and identity.
- [wild-registry](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild-registry.html): registry and lock behavior.
- [wild-bridge](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild-bridge.html): bridging contracts across ecosystems.
- [wild-adopt](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild-adopt.html): adoption workflow and evidence.
- [wild-deploy](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild-deploy.html): deployment and release gating.
- [wild-extract](https://wild.charlyvibes.com/specs/wild-extract.html): extraction profiles and extractor protocol.

## Integration failures

- [Part 1](docs/integration-failures.md): 112 integration failure cases with
  verdicts against the design.
- [Part 2](docs/integration-failures-part2.md): 50 more cases (113 to 162);
  rows 113 to 122 web-checked, the rest from memory.

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
|--------|----------|
| `src/` | Rust implementation of the `wild extract` and `wild check` subcommands |
| `openspec/specs/` | Nine specodelic specs (see above) |
| `prototype/` | Toy checkers and prototype extractors (Python) |
| `experiments/` | Real-project experiments; see `experiments/RESULTS.md` |
| `docs/` | Manual, formats, and integration failure reports |
| `schemas/` | v1 JSON Schema and structural examples |
| `book.toml`, `docs/src/` | mdBook sources for the deployed site |
